description: Get a PC game's catalogue entry without checking live prices: its Game ID, Foxfind page, and each product (base game, editions, DLC) with the stores that list it. Use compare_prices for current prices.

country.description: Two-letter country code for regional pricing (default: "CA"). Supported: CA, US, GB, AU, DE, FR.

game.description: Exact game title, or `game:<Game ID>` from search_games. Must be 2-150 characters.

name: get_game
